scares.description: Tim's mother is shown sitting across the bed from him.
A horrifying face suddenly appears from under the covers.
The bedroom door suddenly opens, revealing Tim's mother, who has gone insane.
There is a jump cut to a close-up of Tim's mother
There is a jump cut to a close-up of Tim's father, who has been dead for some time and is rotting.
There is a loud scream and Millie's arms wrap around Tim's face from behind
The light is turned on, revealing Tim eating Millie's hair. Accompanied by audio scare.
Millie slams into the glass door behind Tim
There is a jump cut to Tim's hand crawling along the floor. Accompanied by an audio scare.
Jamie, who has been out of focus behind Millie, starts speaking.
